query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.companyName,
  s.contactEmail,
  CASE WHEN i.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_intake,
  CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as has_rankings,
  CASE WHEN r.isArchived = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END as is_archived
FROM sponsors s
LEFT JOIN intakeForms i ON s.id = i.sponsorId
LEFT JOIN rankingsSubmissions r ON s.id = r.sponsorId
ORDER BY s.createdAt DESC;
